zh: 桌面端新增运行黑盒：程序异常消失后，下次启动的日志会说明上次未正常退出，并在本地保存崩溃转储，便于定位闪退原因。
Dragon Claw 执行的每条命令的开始与结束都会写入运行日志；页面渲染进程崩溃后主窗口自动重新加载。
桌面宠物已全面停用：不再创建宠物窗口，也不再加载全局键盘监听；托盘里的 Agent 额度侧栏可独立开关。
en: Desktop now keeps a run black box: after the app disappears unexpectedly, the next launch logs that the previous run ended abnormally and keeps crash dumps locally to help locate the cause.
Every command Dragon Claw runs is logged at start and end, and the main window reloads itself after a renderer crash.
The desktop pet is fully disabled: no pet window is created and the global keyboard listener is no longer loaded; the agent quota sidebar can still be toggled from the tray.
